venues.name: Arvo Coffee — Liberty Village
venues.cap: ~50-300 cocktail style (est; blog states range 30-300 for private events, no official number published)
venues.linkText: Events — Arvo Coffee (Liberty Village available for private/cocktail-style events)
venues.note: Specialty third-wave cafe + wine bar in the heart of Liberty Village; its own events page explicitly offers the Liberty Village location for cocktail-style private events, and neighbourhood coverage cites a 30-300 person range with reserveable full espresso-bar service. Cafe-by-day, event-space-by-night separation plus techy, design-forward crowd fit a tech-week coffee/hack day-to-evening flow.
venues.alt: Balzac's Coffee Roasters Liberty Village (43 Hanna Ave) if a daytime-only seated hack setup with giant windows and roastery vibe is preferred — but Balzac's officially states it no longer rents cafe locations for weddings/events, so reach out before assuming.

venues.name: Oretta King West (Oretta Caffe / La Cambusa + Mezzanine)
venues.addr: 633 King St W, Toronto, ON M5V 1M5
venues.cap: 90 standing / 65 seated for the Mezzanine (Soggiorno + L'Attico); La Cambusa cafe room: 40 cocktail / 26 seated; Cantina 24 seated; larger full-venue buyouts via inquiry
venues.linkText: Eventi — private dining & events at Oretta King West
venues.note: La Cambusa visibly operates as the Oretta Caffe by day, then converts to private event space in the evening, and the mezzanine adds a 90-guest standing capacity — a genuine coffee-by-day / event-by-night hybrid on King West. Full buyouts and multiple combinable rooms give headroom for a 150-200-person tech coffee/hack event, with in-house catering and a dedicated event form (Tripleseat).
venues.alt: If 90 guests on its own floor is enough, book just the Mezzanine; for a cafe-first vibe, request La Cambusa with the private side patio.

venues.name: Forno Cultura — King West
venues.addr: 609 King St W, Toronto, ON M5V 1M5
venues.cap: ~50-80 (est; no published event capacity for the King West bakery-cafe)
venues.linkText: FornoCultura — home/locations/catering (events handled by inquiry only)
venues.note: Artisan bakery-coffee house in King West whose Instagram bio notes 'Unique designed spaces for corporate and social gatherings! Private Events available upon request' — handled via direct email rather than a dedicated venue-hire page. Industrial-chic baking space suits a daytime coffee-charged hack session for a smaller squad, but confirm capacity in writing before banking on 50+.
venues.alt: For 100+, pair with adjacent King West space (e.g., WVRST above at 609 King W) or move to Arvo Liberty Village.

venues.name: Jimmy's Coffee — King West (Flagship, 107 Portland)
venues.cap: ~30-50 (est; small flagship cafe + back patio; no published private-event capacity)
venues.linkText: Catering & Events — Jimmy's Coffee (coffee catering for events; venue-hire not published)
venues.note: Iconic King West micro-roaster founded on Portland St with a back room and patio; the events page only publishes coffee-catering (96oz boxes up to 18L Cambros serving 80, plus a 'send a Jimmy' barista option), so use it to fuel your hack off-site or email jimmy@ about an off-hours buyout of the flagship. Realistically caps at the low end of the 50-200 band unless they agree to a full buyout.
venues.alt: Best used as the mobile coffee for an event at a larger Liberty Village space (e.g., Arvo or a studio), rather than as the primary venue itself.

venues.name: StartWell
venues.addr: 784 King St W, Toronto, ON M5V 1N6
venues.cap: 150 per suite (Level Up / Offsite); up to ~300 combined; full-campus takeover available
venues.note: Purpose-built corporate event campus on King West with multiple combinable suites (Level Up, Offsite Venue, Third Floor), free espresso bar, integrated AV/livestream stage support. Track record hosting tech community events (Superhuman AI Build Night, Tech for Canada Conference) makes it a natural fit for a 50-200 person all-day tech coffee/hack event.
venues.alt: StartWell Level Up event space, King St W, Toronto

venues.name: The Loft on King Street (Oliver & Bonacini)
venues.addr: 485 King St W, Floor 3, Toronto, ON M5V 1K4
venues.linkText: O&B venue page for The Loft on King Street
venues.note: Heritage brick-and-beam loft with polished concrete and 1,850 sq ft of open space curated by O&B Hospitality. Reception capacity of 200 covers the full hack-event range; dedicated in-house events team, catering via The Food Dudes / Baro.
venues.alt: The Loft on King Street, brick-and-beam event loft

venues.name: iQ Offices - The King York Terrace & Lounge
venues.addr: 150 King St W, Toronto, ON M5H 1J9
venues.cap: ~250 seated / 300 standing (est across 7,000 sq ft terrace + lounge, per Cvent listing)
venues.note: Premium coworking operator's flagship event product in King West — 27th-floor terrace plus lounge with skyline views and a dedicated events/concierge team. Scales to the upper end of the brief; sister space The Portland Patio (545 King St W, ~90 standing) is a backup for smaller crews.
venues.alt: iQ Offices King York Terrace & Lounge, 150 King St W

venues.name: Acme Works
venues.linkText: Acme Works homepage (events section linked from #events anchor; /events 404s)
venues.note: Indie King West/Niagara coworking space with an explicitly-priced events offering ($150/hr, $1,000/weekend day, up to 120) including kitchen, lounge, games area and rooftop patio. No standalone events page (acmeworks.ca/events 404s); book via contact form.
venues.alt: Acme Works coworking space interior, Niagara St

venues.name: Spaces Liberty Village (80 Atlantic Avenue)
venues.addr: 80 Atlantic Ave, 4th Floor, Toronto, ON M6K 1X9
venues.cap: ~50-100 (est; no published event capacity; meeting rooms and common areas only)
venues.note: IWG's Spaces brand with a large, modern Liberty Village footprint above the East Liberty retail strip, outdoor terrace, and on-site cafe. Centre page lists meeting rooms / day passes but no dedicated Liberty Village event-hire page — events handled via the generic Spaces 'Event spaces' product / contact form, so treat as contact-only.
venues.alt: Spaces Liberty Village coworking interior, 80 Atlantic Ave

venues.name: HotBlack Coffee (Queen West)
venues.addr: 245 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M5V 1Z4
venues.cap: 10-60 guests (published on events page); licensed back patio adds room in summer
venues.linkText: HotBlack Events - Venue Capacities, Catering, Team-Building
venues.note: Purpose-built for events: dedicated page lists a 10-60 guest capacity, stellar sound system + AV hook-ups, cocktail/networking/team-building packages, and a private licensed back patio with firepit. National-competition barista runs the program; right on the Queen West strip at University with two subway stations nearby. Reopened May 2025 under new (longtime GM) ownership and is fully operating per their live homepage.
venues.alt: HotBlack Coffee interior event space with skylights and high ceilings

venues.name: Dark Horse Espresso - Richmond (401 Richmond St W)
venues.addr: 401 Richmond St W, Toronto, ON M5V 3A8
venues.cap: 60 people (published; 1,200 sq ft). Sister rooms on same page: OCAD at 230 Richmond St W holds 45 seated / 75 standing; Spadina at 215 Spadina Ave (Queen & Spadina) holds 40
venues.linkText: Dark Horse Private Events - per-location capacities + booking form
venues.note: A decade of hosting private events across their cafes; the 401 Richmond loft-building room is one block north of Queen in the queen-west creative/Soho House corridor, wheelchair accessible, and daytime buy-outs are explicitly offered alongside evening rentals. Booking is via the on-page form (no email published).
venues.alt: Dark Horse Espresso Richmond location interior used for private events

venues.name: Chloe Cafe
venues.addr: 1267 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M6K 1L5
venues.cap: ~80-85 max for an event (est, per directory listings: 2 spaces, 111.5 sq m)
venues.note: Coffee bar/cafe in a rustic 180-year-old heritage building in West Queen West with crystal chandeliers, an art-deco private room, espresso-bar service, and rentable projector + 100" motorized screen - handles corporate events, workshops and pop-ups. Phone 647-336-4663. Their own events path failed to load, so book by phone/site contact; capacity comes from third-party listings.
venues.alt: Chloe Cafe heritage-building interior on Queen West

venues.name: Cafe 23
venues.addr: 728 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M6J 1E8
venues.cap: ~50-70 (est; interior backroom + enclosed garden patio, no published number)
venues.linkText: @cafe23coffeebar - Private Events & Rentals in bio + events inquiry form
venues.note: Beloved Queen West anchor between Bathurst and Trinity Bellwoods: front room, larger back room and a leafy hidden garden patio that together suit a daytime coffee crawl/hack hangout. Instagram bio explicitly advertises 'Private Events & Rentals' with a dedicated events email and Google Form inquiry link.
venues.alt: Cafe 23 garden patio and vintage interior on Queen St W

venues.name: The Great Hall
venues.addr: 1087 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M6J 1H3
venues.cap: Main Hall 480; Longboat Hall 400; Conversation Room 117; Drawing Room 97
venues.note: Heritage 4-room venue at Queen/Dovercourt with corporate-events focus, state-of-the-art AV, and a dedicated events team; Main Hall (480) plus Longboat/Conversation/Drawing rooms let you scale a 50-200 person all-day tech/hack event across breakout tracks.
venues.alt: Heritage Victorian hall with stage, balcony, and full bar

venues.name: The Parkdale Hall
venues.addr: 1605 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M6R 1A1
venues.cap: Main Hall 750 standing / 400 seated (4,800 sq ft); Atlantis Cafe 50 standing / 30 seated; 12,000 sq ft outdoor lot
venues.note: Restored 1920s theatre on Queen West (Parkdale) with full bar, on-site kitchen/AV/staffing and a 12,000 sq ft lot for overflow; full-service buyout model works well for all-day tech-week coffee/hack programming.
venues.alt: Restored 1920s art-deco theatre with main hall and outdoor lot

venues.name: Society Clubhouse
venues.addr: 967 College St, Toronto, ON (at College & Dovercourt, just north of Queen West)
venues.cap: 175 standing; 3,400 sq ft over two rooms (Community Room + Neighbourhood Room)
venues.note: Women-owned heritage brick-and-beam community space just off Queen West with A/V, in-house sound tech, four washrooms and full buyout option; ideal mid-size (50-175) hack/coffee event one stop north of Queen on Dovercourt.
venues.alt: Brick-and-beam community event space with taproom

closures: The Roastery — Liberty Village (8 Pardee Ave) — permanently closed per libertyvillagetoronto.com; brand continues only at 401 Richmond St W.
Coffee Oysters Champagne (COC) at 214 King St W — closed/rebranding to 'hotel à toi' (currently 'opening soon'), and located in the Entertainment District rather than King West proper, so excluded.
Dark Horse Espresso Bar — 64 Bathurst St (King West) — not yet open ('COMING SOON' on the locations page as of the fetched site); not in itself a closure but excluded until it opens.
Project Spaces King West (73 Bathurst St) — their /king-west URL now redirects to the Camden St (Queen West) page; the King West location appears consolidated/closed. Not included as a venue.
The Beaver (1192 Queen St W) - beloved Queen West cafe/bar and event space, permanently closed; Facebook and CBC Arts confirm it will not reopen at this address
The Welcome Studios (938 Queen St W) - own domain welcomestudios.com is parked/for sale; only third-party listings remain
Workplace One Queen West (51 Wolseley St) - dropped: only 8-10 seat meeting rooms, no 50-200 person event space
BarChef (472 Queen St W) - dropped: barchef.com failed to fetch in this session
StartWell - dropped: location is 784 King St W (King West, not Queen West; venue site says 784, building spans 782-786)
WeWork 240 Richmond St W / 1050 King St W - dropped: not in Queen West
Spaces Queen West (180 John St) - dropped: address is on John St, not Queen West proper
neighborhood_analysis: King West / Liberty Village is Toronto's densest proven tech-event cluster (TechTO Together Toronto, AI Tinkerers at Google King W + Cohere John St); Queen West is the creative-corridor backup. Downtown/MaRS core skipped in this dry-run to cap tool calls.
